services.name: brama
services.summary: The authenticated provider-neutral gateway every Wisent model call goes through.

services.name: weles
services.summary: The browser-automation worker for authorized web workflows.

repair.name: audit-lock
repair.summary: An audit journal lock wedges credential reads, and this step restarts only loaded Skarbiec dependants to restore the audit and object-authorization paths.
repair.proof: Skarbiec health reports ok and the Stado object boundary reports object=true

repair.name: crypto
repair.summary: Stale per-user GnuPG daemons wedge keybox access, and this step replaces those daemons to restore Skarbiec decryption.
repair.proof: Skarbiec readiness reports ok after keyboxd and gpg-agent relaunch

repair.name: acquisition-state
repair.summary: A service-user cutover wedges Skarbiec acquisition state behind foreign ownership or a stale lock, and this step restores the declared owner, mode, and advisory lock.
repair.proof: the acquisition state and advisory lock have the current uid, gid, mode 0600, and no live legacy lock

services.name: stado-control-plane
services.summary: The local control plane: queue coordination and placement for this host's fleet.

repair.name: release-state
repair.summary: Delivered binaries wedge behind their registry-declared versions, and this step restores every absent or behind binary through the verified host release path.
repair.proof: host inventory reports every managed binary at its declared version and release platform

repair.name: agent-skarbiec
repair.summary: A stale agent credential URL wedges secret resolution, and this step restores the Skarbiec endpoint declared for the target by the service directory.
repair.proof: the target's resolved agent.skarbiec.url equals its service-directory endpoint

services.name: stado
services.summary: The core object API for registry, queue and release state.

repair.name: host
repair.summary: Disk pressure, unloaded managed units, or lost stable binds wedge a registry-managed macOS host, and this step restores the host's fixed recovery program.
repair.proof: the recovery report shows disk after cleanup, every managed unit finding, stable-bind findings, and no blocker

repair.name: object-api
repair.summary: A stale launch definition or closed local-store authority wedges the core object API, and this step restores its declared primary root and authenticated object reads.
repair.proof: the loaded object API serves its declared local root and an authenticated object read succeeds

repair.name: release-store
repair.summary: Foreign ownership of one release-catalog coordinate wedges atomic publication, and this step restores only the service's catalog object, metadata, lock, and required parent ownership.
repair.proof: the service's primary and backup release-catalog paths are regular, non-symlink coordinates owned by the service account

repair.name: link
repair.summary: A stale verifier shadow wedges beacon publication from an otherwise reachable host, and this step restores the route bearer grant without rotating it.
repair.proof: a newer beacon is inside the fleet silence threshold and the recorded silence is closed

repair.name: object-verifier
repair.summary: Object namespace drift wedges authenticated object reads, and this step restores the verifier grant to the exact target and local namespace declaration plus host-health.
repair.proof: the preserved verifier bearer reads exactly every declared object item and host-health

repair.name: release-verifier
repair.summary: Publisher declaration drift wedges release publication, and this step restores the release verifier grant to the exact declared publisher item set.
repair.proof: the preserved release verifier bearer reads exactly every declared publisher item

repair.name: service-verifier
repair.summary: Deployer declaration drift wedges service publication, and this step restores the service verifier grant to the exact declared deployer item set.
repair.proof: the preserved service verifier bearer reads exactly every declared deployer item

repair.name: storage-root
repair.summary: A partial primary and backup authority handoff wedges local object storage, and this step starts the fenced source-preserving reconciliation that restores the declared root.
repair.proof: the durable transaction receipt reports its checkpoint, verified object count, writer fence, and accepted resident owner

services.name: transcript-lake
services.summary: Continuously stream local agent transcripts into Transcript Lake.
